# The Silent Bull Market in Dividends

Report 170 | Published 2025-08-31 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2025-8-31/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/170.json)

Income stocks, reserve pressure and a less cautious gold stance.

The Q4 reserve warning worked, while the predicted 2026 end to QT arrived one month earlier. EPD and USB performed well; Truist and OZK lagged. The gold update appropriately admits uncertainty, but reserve-share charts need adjustment for valuation effects.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

### 170-C04

**QT ends in 2026, followed by balance-sheet growth.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | 2026 |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | qt-end-reserve-management-2025 |
| Source blocks | 28, 29 |
| Thesis family | qt-end-reserve-management-2025 |

The sequence was right but the calendar forecast was late: runoff ended December 1, 2025 and purchases began December 12. Reserve-management purchases are operationally different from a commitment to lower long-term yields. Describing them only as QE under another name loses that distinction.

**Direction:** See assessment; evidence is limited to the stated proposition.

**Timing:** 2026

**Mechanism:** Price direction alone does not identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Runoff implementation change](https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_251029) | New York Fed | 2025-10-29 | Verified in the audit

Runoff ended December 1, 2025.

- [Reserve management purchase announcement](https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_251210a) | New York Fed | 2025-12-10 | Verified in the audit

Purchases began December 12, 2025 to maintain ample reserves; initial monthly amount about $40 billion. Technical reserve supply does not itself establish a change in the interest-rate stance.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Dividend versus price returns:** Include reinvestment, ADR fees and tax assumptions Visual inspection: not performed.
- **FAST Graphs and payout histories:** Distribution yield is not risk-adjusted expected return Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Bank cash and domestic liquidity:** Distribution of reserves matters alongside totals Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Gold share of reserves:** Separate physical purchases from price appreciation Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- A high yield is useful only alongside sustainable cash flow and tolerable downside.
- Record changes in conviction without erasing earlier forecasts.

## Verification limitations

- Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
- Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
